INSIDE THE GAME

A few files. A whole voyage.

Open a file to see the actual source running this game. Start with the scoring settings, then follow what happens when you press Send.

HTML creates the controls. CSS sets their appearance. JavaScript responds to your actions and animates the scene.

Make your first change.

Download the complete project, unzip it, and open the folder in Cursor or VS Code. Open scoring.js, change roundSeconds: 25 to roundSeconds: 40, then save.

To run it on your Mac, open Terminal in the unzipped folder and enter python3 -m http.server 8000 --directory dist. Open http://localhost:8000 and start a practice flight. The new timer lasts 40 seconds.

To change a puzzle, open missions.js. Use replaceRound(day, signal, round(...)) to replace a slot in the daily calendar. Each round(...) defines three clues, a hint, direct answers, close answers, related answers, and optional niche answers. Different answers use |. Alternate names for one answer use /. Update MISSION_REVISION after changing the questions; older results are kept in Stats while the new edition starts fresh.
